purpose: Exact four-player colour identities recovered from the Bounty Arena turret flag assets.

evidence.texture: Asset 332 (BATurret) embeds an 8x8 RGBA texture named FlagColors, split into four 4x4 quadrants.
evidence.material_animations: Assets 340/341/342/343 are BTA0 SRT0 tracks on material lambert314 named BATurretFlagBlueM, BATurretFlagGreeM, BATurretFlagPurpM and BATurretFlagRed. Each holds a single frame whose translation_u/translation_v channels select one quadrant.
evidence.confidence: exact; the four UV offsets land on the four quadrants with no residual

slot_order_note: Ordering below follows the archive asset order 340,341,342,343, which is blue, green, purple, red. That is NOT the player slot order; see arena_player_slots.

arena_player_slots.status: exact, from ROM texture data, and independently confirmed by a gameplay video of a live match
arena_player_slots.evidence: Asset 324, Jabba's Tower texture bank, contains four 32x32 numbered corner tiles named ArenaOne, ArenaTwo, ArenaThree and ArenaFour. Their dominant colours give the slot order directly. A capture of the running game shows spawn locator 0, object selector 0, standing on the blue corner, and the match scoreboard lists slots in this same order.

plain_corner_tiles.note: Unnumbered companion tiles in the same bank, named by colour initial rather than slot number.

arena_player_slots.important: The turret-flag quadrant order below is blue, green, purple, red, while the player slot order is blue, green, red, purple. A flag tinted by owning slot therefore cannot index the quadrants by slot number directly; the mapping is not yet recovered.

heart_sprite.notes: translation_u steps 0, -1/3, -2/3 and translation_v steps 0, +1/3, +2/3 walk a 3x3 atlas. Its use as the health pickup is a strong candidate, not a code-proven HUD binding.

MEASURED_slot_ring_colours.source: out/work/menu_shots/ds_inmatch_touch.png - DS in-match bottom screen, BGRA corrected, sampled on each ring stroke.
MEASURED_slot_ring_colours.evidence_tier: RUN - the game s own rendered pixels.
MEASURED_slot_ring_colours.oam_palettes: These are the colours behind OAM palettes 4, 5, 6 and 7, which the sprite list showed each slot using.
MEASURED_slot_ring_colours.ring_geometry: 36px across at x 6..41, slots at y 6, 54, 102, 150 - a 48px pitch.
CORRECTIONS: Slot 2 was (83,198,63) - far too pale against the real (24,211,0).
Slot 3 was (160,3,30) - far too dark against the real (251,0,8), and I had described it as pink from a low-resolution read. It is a bright red.
Slot 4 was (116,0,168) - far too dark against the real (186,0,251), and is magenta rather than purple.

radar_colours_measured.note: The port draws a black field with RED rings. The DS field is near-black blue-purple and the rings are blue-purple. Not yet corrected.
